source_caption_text:
Nah, this “Ah Ha” into “Bodak Yellow” transition was too clean 😮‍💨🔥

Via @nprmusic

Cardi B brought “Bodak Yellow” to her first NPR Tiny Desk performance, giving the 2017 hit a full live-band setup. The song came near the end of her set and instantly switched up the energy in the room.

The way Cardi went from “Ah Ha” straight into “Bodak Yellow” was too smooth. The band followed her perfectly, making the transition feel natural before “Bodak Yellow” came in.

Hearing Cardi perform the song with a live band gave it a different feel from the original while still keeping everything that made the track so recognizable. That switch into “Bodak Yellow” was definitely one of the best parts of the set.

#cardib #live #hiphop
